Messages.Author: badger
Messages.Body:
I have some questions regarding torpor.

1) Does a vampire entering torpor always get tapped or does it depend on
its state before having all its blood removed?

2) Does a vampire in torpor untap at the start of your turn?

3) Does a torporous vampire rescuing itself have to tap and take an
action or does it just spend the 2 blood.

4) If another vampire rescues a torporous vampire and uses the torporous
vampire's blood, do both vampires tap?

5) When a vampire is rescued (either way), does it enter the active
region immediately? Or does that happen during Influence? Untap Phase
or when?

6) If a vamp is untapped, but in torpor and it's rescued by another with
that second vamps' blood, does it have the right to hunt immediately or
does a circumstance of #5 affect that?

As you can see, I know how a vampire can be sent to torpor, but I'm
unclear on how it comes out.

Thanks,

Badger

Messages.Author: Jeff Dai
Messages.Body:
badger <bad...@buffnet.net> wrote:
: I have some questions regarding torpor.

: 1) Does a vampire entering torpor always get tapped or does it depend on
: its state before having all its blood removed?

If you were tapped before going in then your tapped. If you were untapped
then you stay untapped.

: 2) Does a vampire in torpor untap at the start of your turn?

Yes

: 3) Does a torporous vampire rescuing itself have to tap and take an

: action or does it just spend the 2 blood.

Tap and spend the two blood

: 4) If another vampire rescues a torporous vampire and uses the torporous

: vampire's blood, do both vampires tap?

Only the vampire doing the rescue attempt

: 5) When a vampire is rescued (either way), does it enter the active

: region immediately? Or does that happen during Influence? Untap Phase
: or when?

You take the action during your minion phase so if the vampire is untapped
you can immediately take an action with him/her.

: 6) If a vamp is untapped, but in torpor and it's rescued by another with

: that second vamps' blood, does it have the right to hunt immediately or
: does a circumstance of #5 affect that?

I think if at any time you are at 0 blood then the only action that the
vampire can perform is a hunt (it also has to be the first action. No
restorations).

Jeff

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <34F20E...@buffnet.net>, badger <bad...@buffnet.net> wrote:
> 1) Does a vampire entering torpor always get tapped or does it depend on
> its state before having all its blood removed?

Its state (tapped or untapped) doesn't change.

Only two things* tap minions:
1) Taking an action
2) Blocking (successfully).

Only one thing* untaps a minion:
1) The start of the untap phase

* And, as always, as specified on card text.

Going to torpor is none of these, so the state is unaffected.

> 2) Does a vampire in torpor untap at the start of your turn?

Yes.

> 3) Does a torporous vampire rescuing itself have to tap and take an
> action or does it just spend the 2 blood.

"Leave Torpor" is an action. The vampire leaving torpor must tap to take
the action.

> 4) If another vampire rescues a torporous vampire and uses the torporous
> vampire's blood, do both vampires tap?

Only the one taking the action taps, regardless of who pays the cost.

> 5) When a vampire is rescued (either way), does it enter the active
> region immediately? Or does that happen during Influence? Untap Phase
> or when?

Immediately.
It is returned to the active region when the "rescue" or "leave torpor"
action resolves (successfully).

> 6) If a vamp is untapped, but in torpor and it's rescued by another with
> that second vamps' blood, does it have the right to hunt immediately or
> does a circumstance of #5 affect that?

It is free to tap to take an action.
Note: if it is empty, then it *must* hunt (unless some other effect
prevents it from hunting, in which case it can do nothing).
